description: Move a chart on a dashboard and/or change its width. position is the place counting from 0: other charts shift to keep the order. Returns the new layout. Layout: the dashboard is a grid of 3 columns, charts go in the order of their position and wrap into rows. width_size 1 = a third, 2 = two thirds, 3 = a full row. Keep the sum of widths in every row equal to 3 (3, 2+1, 1+2, 1+1+1), otherwise a row has an empty hole. Good widths: a line or bars over time 2 or 3, a funnel 2 or 3 (up to 4 steps fit without scrolling at width 1), TOTAL bars and retention 1 or 2.

position.description: New place counting from 0, unchanged when not set

width_size.description: New width, unchanged when not set

name: analytics_dashboard_set_chart_position
